optimizedContext.value:
# Change Transition

## Rules
- `specd change transition <name> <step> [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--format text|json|toon]`
- `specd change transition <name> --next [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--format text|json|toon]`
- `<name>` required. `<step>` required unless `--next`. States: `designing`, `ready`, `implementing`, `verifying`, `done`, `archivable`, `pending-spec-approval`, `spec-approved`, `pending-signoff`, `signed-off`
- `--next` mutually exclusive with `<step>`
- `--skip-hooks <phases>`: `source.pre`, `source.post`, `target.pre`, `target.post`, `all`. `all` skips every phase. Omit → all applicable hooks run
- `--format text|json|toon` default `text`

### Next-transition resolution
- `--next` loads current state, resolves logical forward target, then runs normal `TransitionChange`. Approval routing, requires, hooks, errors unchanged
- `drafting` → `designing`; `designing` → `ready`; `ready` → `implementing`; `spec-approved` → `implementing`; `implementing` → `verifying`; `verifying` → `done`; `done` → `archivable`
- No transition-driven next action → exit 1 + stderr `error:`. Includes `pending-spec-approval` (human spec approval), `pending-signoff` (human signoff), `archivable` (next action is archive, not another transition)

### Refresh delegation
- MUST NOT call `RefreshImplementationTracking` or `ImplementationDetector` directly
- Pre-transition and repair-guide status: `GetStatus` with `refreshImplementationTracking: false`. `TransitionChange` refreshes; no second refresh solely for diagnostics
- `TransitionChange` uses default `refreshImplementationTrackingBefore` unless a future CLI flag opts out

### Approval-gate routing
- CLI MUST NOT pass approval flags to `TransitionChange.execute`. Routing baked from `config.approvals` at kernel construction. `LifecycleEngine`:
- `ready` + `config.approvals.spec` true → `implementing` silently routes to `pending-spec-approval`
- `done` + `config.approvals.signoff` true → `archivable` silently routes to `pending-signoff`
- User specifies logical target or `--next` target. CLI must not duplicate routing

### Hook execution
- Default order: source.post, then target.pre, then state transition. Both phases fail-fast
- `--skip-hooks` skips named phases. `--skip-hooks all` skips all; caller uses `specd change run-hooks`
- Maps to `skipHookPhases` on `TransitionChangeInput`

### Progress output
- `onProgress`: step feedback in `text`; structured progress for machine formats
- Hook progress MUST show start, active hook ID and command, recent output while running, liveness when active without new output, completion
- `text` running label MAY exist but MUST NOT be the only liveness signal. Completed-hook progress MUST stay readable, not fully overwritten
- `json`/`toon`: newline-delimited stdout records. Hook events `stream: "hook-progress"`. Transition events (`requires-check`, `transitioned`) `stream: "change-transition"`
- Surface hook progress during transition even if it fails before state changes
- Same presentation model as `specd change run-hooks` via shared helper: running-status labels, recent-output tail, liveness signalling, failed-hook full-output rendering

### Output on success
- `text`: final human-readable confirmation on stdout after progress
- `json`/`toon`: one terminal stdout record in the same stream: `stream: "change-transition"`, `event.type: "complete"`, `event.result` with `result`, `name`, `from`, `to`. Not a standalone object outside the stream

### Errors
- Hook failure → exit 2 + stderr `error:`. No separate post-transition hook warning. Prior progress MUST still show active hook and preceding output
- Invalid transition → exit 1 + stderr `error:`. Text mode Repair Guide on `InvalidStateTransitionError` or `HookFailedError`:

```
error: cannot transition to <step>
! <CODE>: <message>

repair guide:
  target:  <targetStep>
  command: <command>
  reason:  <reason>
```

- Guide uses `nextAction` from `GetStatusResult`. `! <CODE>` uses GetStatus blocker codes (e.g. `MISSING_ARTIFACT`, `ARTIFACT_DRIFT`)
- `json`/`toon` failure stays on stdout: terminal `stream: "change-transition"`, `event.type: "complete"`, `event.result` with `result: "failure"`, `name`, `from`, `to`, `blockers`, `nextAction`
- `InvalidStateTransitionError` structured human-approval/signoff reason MUST appear in stderr, not a generic invalid-transition message
- `--next` with no transition-driven next action: stderr explains why automatic advance is impossible
- `implementing` → `verifying` with incomplete tasks (`taskCompletionCheck.incompletePattern`) → exit 1 + stderr `error:` naming blocking artifact
- Target `requires` unmet (artifact not `complete` or `skipped`) → exit 1 + stderr `error:`

## Constraints
- User specifies logical target; help text never exposes routing
- Repair-guide blockers and next-action come from core diagnostics (`TransitionChange` failure plus `GetStatus`), not recomputed in CLI
- Text: progress on stderr; final confirmation on stdout
- `json`/`toon`: progress and terminal complete record on stdout; stderr for non-structured diagnostics
